image-editor.chunk.as-on-a-card.note: Button that previews the drawing as it looks on a card.

image-editor.chunk.canvas-size-set-to-w-.note: Message after the canvas size changes. {w} is the new width and {h} the new height, as plain numbers in drawing units.

vars.h: The value that replaces h in the text.
vars.w: The value that replaces w in the text.

image-editor.chunk.could-not-reach-magic.text: Could not reach Magic Card Utils. Your work is safe.
image-editor.chunk.could-not-reach-magic.note: Error message after a failed save or load of the image library. It tells the user the server was unreachable and the drawing is still in the editor.

image-editor.chunk.ctrl-z-undo-ctrl-shif.text: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z redo, Ctrl+S Save, T text
image-editor.chunk.ctrl-z-undo-ctrl-shif.note: Keyboard shortcut hint for the drawing area. Key names stay as written; only the action words are translated.

image-editor.chunk.draw-something-first.note: Tooltip on a disabled action such as Save while the canvas is empty. It tells the user to add a shape before using it.

image-editor.chunk.duplicate.note: Menu item that copies this image under a new name. The dots mean a name dialog follows.

image-editor.chunk.fine.note: Lower-case size status word for a small image. It fills the word slot in the size line, not a sentence of its own.

image-editor.chunk.getting-big.note: Lower-case size status word for an image nearing the size limit. It fills the word slot in the size line.

image-editor.chunk.give-it-a-name.note: Validation message in the save dialog when the name box is empty. It tells the user to type a name before saving.

image-editor.chunk.image-canvas.note: Accessible name of the drawing area, read by screen readers. Same English as the canvas section title in the inspector.

image-editor.chunk.image-editor.note: Title of the whole image editor window, also its accessible name.

image-editor.chunk.image-name.note: Label of the text box where the user names the image in the save dialog.

image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.text: Image size: {used} KiB of 256 KiB. Fine.
image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.note: Size message for a small image. {used} is the size so far in KiB, a number. Same wording family as the getting big, nearly full and too big variants.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.text: Image size: {used} KiB of 256 KiB. Getting big. Large images can be slow on wall tablets.
image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.note: Size message when the image nears the limit. {used} is the size so far in KiB, a number.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.text: Image size: {used} KiB of 256 KiB. Nearly full. You can add a little more.
image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.note: Size message when the image is close to the limit but still saves. {used} is the size so far in KiB, a number.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.text: Image size: {used} KiB of 256 KiB. Too big to save.
image-editor.chunk.image-size-used-kib-o.note: Size message when the image is over the limit and cannot be saved. {used} is the size so far in KiB, a number.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

image-editor.chunk.images-need-magic-car.text: Images need Magic Card Utils. It is installed through HACS, like Magic Card.
image-editor.chunk.images-need-magic-car.note: Message in the image editor when the companion integration is missing. It tells the user what to install and how.

image-editor.chunk.import-an-svg-file.note: Menu item that opens a file picker to bring an SVG drawing into the editor. The dots mean a dialog follows.

image-editor.chunk.imported-name.note: Message after an SVG file is imported. {name} is the file name. Keep the single quotes around it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.chunk.magic-card-utils-repo.text: Magic Card Utils reported an error and did not finish. Your work is safe. Use Export file to keep a copy.
image-editor.chunk.magic-card-utils-repo.note: Error message when the server answers with a failure. It tells the user the drawing is intact and points to Export file as a backup.

image-editor.chunk.my-image.note: Default name suggested for a new image before the user types their own.

image-editor.chunk.name-copy.note: Suggested name for a duplicate. {name} is the name of the original image.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.chunk.name-stays-locked-imp.text: {name} stays locked: imported parts cannot be edited.
image-editor.chunk.name-stays-locked-imp.note: Message when the user tries to edit an imported layer. {name} is the layer name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.chunk.nearly-full.note: Lower-case size status word for an image close to the limit. It fills the word slot in the size line.

image-editor.chunk.opacity-set-to-pct-so.text: Opacity set to {pct} % so the reference picture shows through. Change it in Opacity.
image-editor.chunk.opacity-set-to-pct-so.note: Message after the layer opacity is lowered automatically. {pct} is a whole number from 0 to 100. Opacity at the end is the name of the field.

vars.pct: The value that replaces pct in the text.

image-editor.chunk.save-as-a-copy.note: Menu item that saves the image under a new name and leaves the original unchanged. Dots mean a dialog follows.

image-editor.chunk.save-the-image-first.note: Tooltip on a disabled action that needs a saved image, shown while the image is new. It tells the user to save first.

image-editor.chunk.save-your-changes-fir.note: Tooltip on a disabled action that needs the saved version, shown while there are unsaved edits. It tells the user to save first.

image-editor.chunk.saved.note: Short status shown after the image has been saved, past tense.

image-editor.chunk.saved-as-name-the-ori.text: Saved as ‘{name}’. The original is unchanged.
image-editor.chunk.saved-as-name-the-ori.note: Message after saving a copy. {name} is the name of the new copy. Keep the single quotes around it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.chunk.saved-name.note: Message after saving an image. {name} is the image name. Keep the single quotes around it.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.chunk.saving.note: Status shown while the image is being saved. Same English as the save button busy label.

image-editor.chunk.showing-the-drawing-a.text: Showing the drawing as on a card, with the entity off.
image-editor.chunk.showing-the-drawing-a.note: Screen reader announcement after the user switches the preview to the card view. It tells them the entity-off look is being shown.

image-editor.chunk.showing-the-drawing-i.text: Showing the drawing in the editor colours.
image-editor.chunk.showing-the-drawing-i.note: Screen reader announcement after the user switches the preview back to the editor view. It tells them the drawing shows its own colours.

image-editor.chunk.text.note: Name of the text tool in the toolbar. A noun, not a verb.

image-editor.chunk.text-tool-click-or-ta.text: Text tool. Click or tap where the text goes, or press Enter to start in the middle. Type, then press Enter or Done.
image-editor.chunk.text-tool-click-or-ta.note: Screen reader announcement when the text tool is picked. It explains how to place, type and finish a text layer. Key names stay as written.

image-editor.chunk.that-drawing-is-over-.note: Error when the library refuses a save because the drawing is too large. It tells the user the size limit.

image-editor.chunk.that-file-cannot-be-u.text: That file cannot be used as an image.
image-editor.chunk.that-file-cannot-be-u.note: Error after opening a file that the image editor rejects for a reason with no specific message. Nothing is loaded.

image-editor.chunk.that-file-has-no-shap.text: That file has no shapes an image can use.
image-editor.chunk.that-file-has-no-shap.note: Error after opening an SVG that holds nothing drawable. It tells the user the file was not loaded.

image-editor.chunk.that-svg-is-too-big-t.text: That SVG is too big to open (over 8 MB). Try a smaller copy.
image-editor.chunk.that-svg-is-too-big-t.note: Error when a pasted or chosen SVG is over the 8 MB open limit. It tells the user the limit and to try a smaller file.

image-editor.chunk.the-library-does-not-.text: The library does not accept the text "{word}", in the layer "{name}". Change it, then save again.
image-editor.chunk.the-library-does-not-.note: Error when a text layer holds a blocked word. {word} is the rejected word and {name} is the layer name. Keep the quote marks.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.
vars.word: The value that replaces word in the text.

image-editor.chunk.the-library-does-not-.text: The library does not accept the text "{word}". Change it, then save again.
image-editor.chunk.the-library-does-not-.note: Error when some text in the image is blocked and no layer is named. {word} is the rejected word. Keep the quote marks.

vars.word: The value that replaces word in the text.

image-editor.chunk.the-library-is-full-2.text: The library is full (200 images). Delete one to add another.
image-editor.chunk.the-library-is-full-2.note: Error when saving a new image while the library holds its maximum. It tells the user the limit and to delete an image first.

image-editor.chunk.the-library-refused-t.note: Error after the image library rejects a save. {reason} is a reason text from the library, inserted after the colon.

vars.reason: The value that replaces reason in the text.

image-editor.chunk.the-library-refused-t.text: The library refused this image. Use Export file to keep a copy.
image-editor.chunk.the-library-refused-t.note: Error when the library rejects a save for a reason with no specific message. It points the user to Export file as a backup.

image-editor.chunk.the-reference-picture.text: The reference picture was not saved.
image-editor.chunk.the-reference-picture.note: Notice after saving an image that has a tracing picture loaded. It tells the user the picture is never stored with the image.

image-editor.chunk.this-drawing-cannot-b.text: This drawing cannot be saved as an image.
image-editor.chunk.this-drawing-cannot-b.note: Error when the drawing fails the check before saving. It tells the user nothing was saved.

image-editor.chunk.this-image-has-parts-.text: This image has parts that this editor cannot change yet, so it opens for viewing only.
image-editor.chunk.this-image-has-parts-.note: Banner on an image the editor cannot edit safely. It tells the user the image is read-only and why.

image-editor.chunk.this-image-is-no-long.text: This image is no longer in the library.
image-editor.chunk.this-image-is-no-long.note: Error when saving an image that was deleted elsewhere in the meantime. It tells the user the stored copy is gone.

image-editor.chunk.this-image-was-change.text: This image was changed somewhere else.
image-editor.chunk.this-image-was-change.note: Message when a save finds a newer version in the library. Same English as the notice in the inspector, which comes with a Reload button.

image-editor.chunk.this-is-not-valid-svg.text: This is not valid SVG. Check that it starts with <svg and is closed.
image-editor.chunk.this-is-not-valid-svg.note: Error when pasted markup cannot be parsed. It tells the user what a valid SVG looks like. Keep the literal tag as written.

image-editor.chunk.too-big.note: Lower-case size status word for an image over the limit. It fills the word slot in the size line.

image-editor.chunk.too-big-to-save.note: Short label on the disabled save button when the image is over the size limit.

image-editor.chunk.too-big-to-save-used-.text: Too big to save: {used} KiB of 256 KiB.
image-editor.chunk.too-big-to-save-used-.note: Error message when saving is refused for size. {used} is the current size in KiB, a number.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

image-editor.chunk.undo.note: Name of the undo action as a short toolbar label or tooltip. A verb.

image-editor.chunk.use-80-characters-or-.note: Validation message under the image name box in the save dialog. It tells the user the name length limit.

image-editor.chunk.you-can-look-at-this-.text: You can look at this image but not change it. Ask an administrator.
image-editor.chunk.you-can-look-at-this-.note: Banner for a user without edit rights. It tells them the image is read-only and who can change that.

image-editor.importer.choose-an-svg-file.note: Error when a chosen file is not an SVG. It tells the user to pick a file of that type.

image-editor.importer.choose-another-fil.note: Button in the import dialog that goes back to the file picker.

image-editor.importer.close.note: Button that closes the import dialog without importing.

image-editor.importer.continue.note: Button in the import dialog that goes ahead and opens the cleaned file.

image-editor.importer.could-not-import-t.note: Title of the import dialog when the file failed. The reason is shown below it.

image-editor.importer.embedded-pictures.note: Lower-case item in the list of removed parts, joined into the Removed sentence. Means bitmap pictures stored inside the SVG.

image-editor.importer.event-handlers.note: Lower-case item in the list of removed parts. Means code attributes such as onclick that run scripts when the SVG is used.

image-editor.importer.imported-file.note: Fallback image name used when an imported SVG file has no name of its own.

image-editor.importer.imported-name.note: Title of the import dialog after a successful import. {name} is the file name. Keep the single quotes.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.importer.importing-name-rep.text: Importing ‘{name}’ replaces everything on the canvas. You can undo it.
image-editor.importer.importing-name-rep.note: Warning in the replace dialog. {name} is the file name. Keep the single quotes.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.importer.keep-my-drawing.note: Button in the replace dialog that cancels the import and keeps the current drawing.

image-editor.importer.links-to-another-s.note: Lower-case item in the list of removed parts. Means references that would load something from an outside web address.

image-editor.importer.nothing-was-remove.note: Line in the import summary when cleaning dropped no parts of the file. It tells the user the SVG came in complete.

image-editor.importer.other-parts-an-ima.text: other parts an image cannot use
image-editor.importer.other-parts-an-ima.note: Lower-case catch-all item in the list of removed parts, joined into the Removed sentence.

image-editor.importer.removed-list.note: Summary after import. {list} is a comma-separated list of lower-case items, such as scripts and embedded pictures.

vars.list: The value that replaces list in the text.

image-editor.importer.replace.note: Button in the replace dialog that swaps the current drawing for the imported file. A verb.

image-editor.importer.replace-your-drawi.note: Title of the dialog that asks before an import overwrites the current drawing.

image-editor.importer.scripts.note: Lower-case item in the list of removed parts. Means embedded program code, not film scripts.

image-editor.importer.some-parts-cannot-.text: Some parts cannot be edited, such as clipped ones. They are kept as locked layers.
image-editor.importer.some-parts-cannot-.note: Line in the import summary for parts the editor cannot change. It tells the user they stay visible as locked layers.

image-editor.importer.that-file-is-too-b.text: That file is too big to open (over 8 MB). Try a smaller copy.
image-editor.importer.that-file-is-too-b.note: Error when a chosen SVG file is over the 8 MB open limit. It tells the user the limit and to try a smaller file.

image-editor.importer.the-file-could-not.text: The file could not be read.
image-editor.importer.the-file-could-not.note: Error when the browser fails to read the chosen file. It tells the user to try the file again or another one.

image-editor.paint-ui.a-gradient-needs-a.text: A gradient needs at least 2 stops.
image-editor.paint-ui.a-gradient-needs-a.note: Validation message in the gradient editor when the user removes below the minimum. It tells them the lowest stop count.

image-editor.paint-ui.accent.note: Colour choice that follows the Home Assistant accent (primary) colour of the theme. Same English as the Accent entry in the inspector.

image-editor.paint-ui.add-stop.note: Button that adds a colour stop to a gradient. A stop is one colour point along the gradient.

image-editor.paint-ui.angle-degrees.note: Field label for the direction of a linear gradient, as a number of degrees.

image-editor.paint-ui.at-most-8-stops.note: Validation message in the gradient editor when the user adds beyond the limit. It tells them the highest stop count.

image-editor.paint-ui.centre-x.note: Field label for the horizontal centre of a radial gradient, as a percentage of the width.

image-editor.paint-ui.centre-y.note: Field label for the vertical centre of a radial gradient, as a percentage of the height.

image-editor.paint-ui.custom.note: Option in the colour source list for a colour the user picks or types. Same English as the canvas size option Custom.

image-editor.paint-ui.custom-colour.note: Label of the colour picker for a freely chosen colour.

image-editor.paint-ui.dash-list.note: Field label for the numbers that set dash and gap lengths of a dashed outline.

image-editor.paint-ui.dash-offset.note: Field label for how far along the outline the dash pattern starts, as a number.

image-editor.paint-ui.dashed.note: Outline style option: a line made of dashes. An adjective, one of Solid, Dashed and Dotted.

image-editor.paint-ui.dashes.note: Group heading above the dash settings of an outline. A plural noun.

image-editor.paint-ui.dotted.note: Outline style option: a line made of dots. An adjective, one of Solid, Dashed and Dotted.

image-editor.paint-ui.fill.note: Label for the colour inside a shape, as opposed to its outline. A noun.

image-editor.paint-ui.gradient-centre.note: Accessible name of the draggable handle that sets the centre of a radial gradient.

image-editor.paint-ui.gradient-end.note: Accessible name of the draggable handle at the end point of a linear gradient.

image-editor.paint-ui.gradient-radius.note: Accessible name of the draggable handle that sets the size of a radial gradient.

image-editor.paint-ui.gradient-start.note: Accessible name of the draggable handle at the start point of a linear gradient.

image-editor.paint-ui.gradient-stop-n-of.note: Accessible name of a gradient stop handle. {n} is its number and {count} the total number of stops.

vars.count: The value that replaces count in the text.
vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.label-x-x-y-y.note: Accessible name of a gradient handle with its position. {label} is the handle name, {x} and {y} are coordinates as numbers.

vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.
vars.x: The value that replaces x in the text.
vars.y: The value that replaces y in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.linear-gradient.note: Fill type option: colours blend along a straight line. Same English as the entry in the inspector.

image-editor.paint-ui.main.note: Colour choice that follows the main text colour of the theme. Not the primary action. Same English as the entry in the inspector.

image-editor.paint-ui.more-style-options.note: Label of the expander that reveals extra outline settings such as dashes.

image-editor.paint-ui.name-colour.note: Accessible name of a colour field. {name} is the field it belongs to, for example Fill or Outline.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.none.note: Option meaning no paint at all, so the fill or outline is transparent. Same English as the entry in the inspector.

image-editor.paint-ui.opacity.note: Slider label for how see-through the paint is. Same English as the reference picture opacity.

image-editor.paint-ui.opacity-fades-the-.note: Hint beside the layer opacity slider. It tells the user the setting affects fill and outline together.

image-editor.paint-ui.or-type-a-name.note: Label of a text box where the user types a CSS variable name instead of picking a colour.

image-editor.paint-ui.paint-colour.note: Accessible name of a colour control. {paint} is the paint role, for example Fill or Outline.

vars.paint: The value that replaces paint in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.radial-gradient.note: Fill type option: colours blend outwards from a centre point. Same English as the entry in the inspector.

image-editor.paint-ui.radius.note: Field label for the size of a radial gradient, as a percentage of the image.

image-editor.paint-ui.remove-stop-n.note: Button that removes one gradient stop. {n} is the stop number, counting from 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.solid.note: Option for one flat colour without a gradient, and the plain unbroken outline style.

image-editor.paint-ui.stop-n.note: Label of one gradient colour stop. {n} is its number, counting from 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.stop-n-colour.note: Accessible name of the colour of one gradient stop. {n} is the stop number, counting from 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.stop-n-position.note: Field label for where one gradient stop sits along the gradient. {n} is the stop number; the value is a percentage.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.paint-ui.stroke.note: Label for the outline line of a shape, as opposed to its fill. A noun, not a gesture.

image-editor.paint-ui.theme-colour.note: Heading of the group of colours that come from the Home Assistant theme and change with it.

image-editor.paint-ui.use-a-colour-like-.note: Validation message under the colour box for a value that is not a colour. It gives a hex example. Keep the example as written.

image-editor.paint-ui.use-a-name-that-st.text: Use a name that starts with two dashes, like --my-colour.
image-editor.paint-ui.use-a-name-that-st.note: Validation message under the theme variable box for a name in the wrong form. It gives an example. Keep the example as written.

image-editor.paint-ui.use-up-to-8-number.text: Use up to 8 numbers separated by spaces, like 8 4.
image-editor.paint-ui.use-up-to-8-number.note: Validation message under the dash pattern box for a bad value. It tells the user the format and gives an example.

image-editor.part.imported-part.note: Name of a locked layer that came from an imported SVG and cannot be edited.

image-editor.part.rename-reorder-hide-or.text: Rename, reorder, hide or delete it.
image-editor.part.rename-reorder-hide-or.note: Hint on a layer row that the layer can be managed from its menu. It lists what the user can do with it.

image-editor.part.this-part-keeps-its-ow.text: This part keeps its own colours.
image-editor.part.this-part-keeps-its-ow.note: Hint on a locked part from an imported file. It tells the user the colour controls do not apply to it.

image-editor.reference-ui.alignment-is-r.text: Alignment is remembered on this device for this image. The picture is not.
image-editor.reference-ui.alignment-is-r.note: Hint in the tracing picture panel. It tells the user that only the position is kept, and only on this device.

image-editor.reference-ui.choose-a-pictu.note: Button that opens a file picker for a reference picture to trace. Dots mean a picker follows.

image-editor.reference-ui.choose-another.note: Button that replaces the current reference picture with another one. Dots mean a picker follows.

image-editor.reference-ui.close.note: Button that closes the reference picture panel. The picture stays as it is.

image-editor.reference-ui.fit-to-canvas.note: Button that scales and centres the reference picture so it fits inside the canvas.

image-editor.reference-ui.for-tracing-on.text: For tracing only. The picture is never saved.
image-editor.reference-ui.for-tracing-on.note: Hint in the tracing picture panel. It tells the user the picture is a guide and is not part of the saved image.

image-editor.reference-ui.hide.note: Button that hides the reference picture without removing it. A verb, paired with Show.

image-editor.reference-ui.match-canvas-s.text: Match canvas shape to this picture
image-editor.reference-ui.match-canvas-s.note: Button that resizes the canvas to the same proportions as the reference picture.

image-editor.reference-ui.move-picture-d.note: Arrow button that nudges the reference picture downwards. Accessible name.

image-editor.reference-ui.move-picture-l.note: Arrow button that nudges the reference picture to the left. Accessible name.

image-editor.reference-ui.move-picture-r.note: Arrow button that nudges the reference picture to the right. Accessible name.

image-editor.reference-ui.move-picture-u.note: Arrow button that nudges the reference picture upwards. Accessible name.

image-editor.reference-ui.move-the-pictu.note: Heading of the group of arrow buttons that move the reference picture.

image-editor.reference-ui.opacity.note: Slider label for how see-through the reference picture is. Same English as the paint opacity label.

image-editor.reference-ui.png-jpeg-webp-.text: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF or BMP.
image-editor.reference-ui.png-jpeg-webp-.note: Hint listing the accepted picture file types. Format names stay as written.

image-editor.reference-ui.reference-pict.note: Panel title for a faint picture shown under the canvas to trace over. It is never saved with the image.
Status line in the reference picture panel. Same English as the toast with the same wording.

image-editor.reference-ui.reference-pict.text: Reference pictures are not kept. Pick it again if you reopen the image.
image-editor.reference-ui.reference-pict.note: Hint in the tracing picture panel. It tells the user to choose the picture again after reopening the image.

image-editor.reference-ui.remove-picture.note: Button that removes the reference picture from the editor.

image-editor.reference-ui.reset-alignmen.note: Button that puts the reference picture back to its default position, scale and rotation.

image-editor.reference-ui.rotate-degrees.note: Field label for turning the reference picture by a number of degrees.

image-editor.reference-ui.scale.note: Field label for the size of the reference picture as a percentage of its original size.

image-editor.reference-ui.scale-and-rota.text: Scale and rotate are around the middle of the picture.
image-editor.reference-ui.scale-and-rota.note: Hint beside the tracing picture scale and rotate controls. It tells the user which point the picture turns around.

image-editor.reference-ui.show.note: Button that shows a hidden reference picture again. A verb, paired with Hide.

image-editor.reference-ui.turn-left-90.note: Button that turns the reference picture 90 degrees anticlockwise. The degree sign is left out on purpose.

image-editor.reference-ui.turn-right-90.note: Button that turns the reference picture 90 degrees clockwise. The degree sign is left out on purpose.

image-editor.reference-ui.x.note: Field label for the horizontal position of the reference picture. Single letter, the x axis.

image-editor.reference-ui.y.note: Field label for the vertical position of the reference picture. Single letter, the y axis.

image-editor.reference.choose-a-png-jpeg.text: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, AVIF or BMP picture.
image-editor.reference.choose-a-png-jpeg.note: Error when the chosen file is not a supported picture type. Format names stay as written.

image-editor.reference.reference-picture.note: Toast shown when a reference picture is loaded. Same English as the status line in the panel.

image-editor.reference.that-file-is-too-.text: That file is too big to open (over 64 MB). Try a smaller copy.
image-editor.reference.that-file-is-too-.note: Error when a tracing picture is over the 64 MB limit. It tells the user the limit and to try a smaller file.

image-editor.reference.this-browser-cann.text: This browser cannot open that picture. Save it as a JPEG and try again.
image-editor.reference.this-browser-cann.note: Error when a tracing picture is in a format the browser cannot decode. It suggests converting to JPEG.

image-editor.reference.your-last-alignme.text: Your last alignment for this image was applied.
image-editor.reference.your-last-alignme.note: Notice after a tracing picture loads. It tells the user the remembered position and scale were restored.

image-editor.text-tool.cancel.note: Button that closes the text entry box and throws away what was typed.

image-editor.text-tool.done.note: Button that adds the typed text to the canvas and closes the text entry box.

image-editor.text-tool.enter-adds-the-te.text: Enter adds the text. Shift+Enter starts a new line. Esc cancels.
image-editor.text-tool.enter-adds-the-te.note: Keyboard hint while typing a new text layer. It lists the keys to confirm, break a line or cancel. Key names stay as written.

image-editor.text-tool.n-left.note: Counter under the text entry box. {n} is how many characters can still be typed. Same English as the counter in the text panel.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.text-tool.no-text-was-added.note: Screen reader announcement when the text tool closes with an empty box. It tells the user no layer was created.

image-editor.text-tool.text-cancelled.note: Status message in the image editor after the user abandons adding text to the canvas.

image-editor.text-tool.text-on-the-canva.note: Accessible name of the text entry box that appears over the drawing area.

image-editor.text-tool.that-is-the-longe.text: That is the longest text (2048 characters).
image-editor.text-tool.that-is-the-longe.note: Status message from the text tool when typed text hits the 2048 character limit. The text-ui key with the same English is the one shown by the text panel.

image-editor.text-ui.add-text.note: Button that starts the text tool to place new text on the canvas. A verb and its object.

image-editor.text-ui.alignment.note: Label of the text alignment choice: start, centre or end of the line. Not the reference picture alignment.

image-editor.text-ui.bold.note: Font weight option, a heavier weight than Medium and Semi-bold.

image-editor.text-ui.centre.note: Text alignment option: lines sit in the middle. Paired with Start and End.

image-editor.text-ui.clean-no-feet.note: Short hint under the Sans-serif font option. Feet means the small strokes at letter ends.

image-editor.text-ui.content.note: Label of the field that holds the words of the text layer. A noun.

image-editor.text-ui.end.note: Text alignment option: lines end at the edge, which is right in left-to-right languages. Paired with Start and Centre.

image-editor.text-ui.enter-adds-a-line.note: Keyboard hint in the text layer inspector. It tells the user that Enter breaks the line here. The key name stays as written.

image-editor.text-ui.every-letter-the-sa.note: Short hint under the Monospace font option.

image-editor.text-ui.extra-bold.note: Font weight option, heavier than Bold.

image-editor.text-ui.font.note: Label of the font family choice, such as Sans-serif or Serif.

image-editor.text-ui.italic.note: Option for slanted letters in the text style choice.

image-editor.text-ui.letter-spacing-unit.note: Field label for the extra gap between letters, in drawing units.

image-editor.text-ui.light.note: Font weight option with thin strokes. Not the light theme and not lighting.

image-editor.text-ui.medium.note: Font weight option between Regular and Semi-bold. Not a size.

image-editor.text-ui.monospace.note: Font family option where every letter has the same width, like code.

image-editor.text-ui.n-left.note: Counter under the text content field. {n} is how many characters can still be typed. Same English as the counter in the text entry box.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

image-editor.text-ui.regular.note: Font weight option for normal strokes, the default.

image-editor.text-ui.sans-serif.note: Font family option for letters without small end strokes. Keep the typographic term.

image-editor.text-ui.semi-bold.note: Font weight option between Medium and Bold.

image-editor.text-ui.serif.note: Font family option for letters with small end strokes. Keep the typographic term.

image-editor.text-ui.size-units.note: Field label for the text height, in drawing units.

image-editor.text-ui.start.note: Text alignment option: lines begin at the edge, which is left in left-to-right languages. Paired with Centre and End.

image-editor.text-ui.style.note: Label of the choice between upright and italic letters.

image-editor.text-ui.system.note: Font family option that uses the device's own interface font.

image-editor.text-ui.text.note: Heading of the text layer settings panel. A noun. Same English as the text tool name.

image-editor.text-ui.text-uses-fonts-alr.text: Text uses fonts already on the device. Nothing is downloaded, so it can look a little different on another device.
image-editor.text-ui.text-uses-fonts-alr.note: Hint under the font choice in the text inspector. It warns that the lettering depends on the fonts of the viewing device.

image-editor.text-ui.that-is-the-longest.text: That is the longest text (2048 characters).
image-editor.text-ui.that-is-the-longest.note: Message in the text panel when the text field reaches the 2048 character limit. The text-tool key with the same English is shown by the canvas tool.

image-editor.text-ui.the-empty-text-laye.text: The empty text layer was removed.
image-editor.text-ui.the-empty-text-laye.note: Screen reader announcement after a text layer is cleared of all text. It tells the user the layer was deleted.

image-editor.text-ui.weight.note: Label of the font weight choice, how heavy the letters look. Not a physical weight.

image-editor.text-ui.whatever-this-devic.text: Whatever this device uses for its own screens.
image-editor.text-ui.whatever-this-devic.note: Short hint under the System font option.

image-editor.text-ui.with-small-feet-lik.note: Short hint under the Serif font option. Feet means the small strokes at letter ends.

image-editor.ui.accent.note: Name of the theme accent colour, used as a colour swatch label in the inspector. Same English as the paint option.

image-editor.ui.apply.note: Button in the canvas size dialog that confirms the new size. A verb.

image-editor.ui.apply-anyway.note: Button that confirms the new canvas size even though some layers will be cut off.

image-editor.ui.author.note: Label of the field for the person who made the image, shown in its details. A noun.

image-editor.ui.back.note: Button that leaves the image editor and returns to the image library.

image-editor.ui.c.text: {c, plural, one {Delete # hidden layer} other {Delete # hidden layers}}
image-editor.ui.c.note: Button that deletes all hidden layers to save space. {c} is the number of hidden layers; the text has singular and plural forms.

vars.c: The count the text is about.

image-editor.ui.c-2.text: {c, plural, one {Deleted # hidden layer.} other {Deleted # hidden layers.}}
image-editor.ui.c-2.note: Message after hidden layers were deleted. {c} is how many were deleted; the text has singular and plural forms.

vars.c: The count the text is about.

image-editor.ui.c-outside-the-new-canvas.text: {c, plural, one {# layer sits} other {# layers sit}} outside the new canvas. They are kept but will be cut off.
image-editor.ui.c-outside-the-new-canvas.note: Warning in the canvas size dialog. {c} is the number of layers outside the new size; the verb must agree with the plural form.

vars.c: The count the text is about.

image-editor.ui.cancel.note: Button that closes the canvas size dialog without changing anything.

image-editor.ui.canvas.note: Short heading for the drawing area settings in the inspector. A noun, not cloth.

image-editor.ui.canvas-size.note: Title of the dialog where the width and height of the drawing area are set.

image-editor.ui.cards-that-set-their-own.text: Cards that set their own shape keep it. In each card's image field, choose 'Use the drawing's shape' to follow the new one.
image-editor.ui.cards-that-set-their-own.note: Hint beside the image shape setting. It tells the user a change does not reach cards with their own shape and how to make them follow it.

image-editor.ui.close.note: Button that closes a notice or panel in the editor without any other action.

image-editor.ui.custom.note: Canvas size option for a width and height typed by the user. Same English as the colour option Custom.

image-editor.ui.description.note: Label of the field for a short text about what the image shows. A noun.

image-editor.ui.duplicate.note: Button that copies the selected layer or image. A verb, without the dots of the menu item.

image-editor.ui.export-file.note: Button that downloads the image as an SVG file, used to keep a copy outside the library.

image-editor.ui.fill-paint.note: Summary line of a layer fill. {paint} is a colour name or value, or a word such as None.

vars.paint: The value that replaces paint in the text.

image-editor.ui.fit-to-view.note: Button that zooms the drawing area so the whole canvas is visible.

image-editor.ui.height.note: Field label for the canvas height, as a number in drawing units.

image-editor.ui.image.note: Heading of the inspector section for the whole image, such as its name and details. A noun.

image-editor.ui.image-canvas.note: Title of the canvas section in the inspector. Same English as the accessible name of the drawing area.

image-editor.ui.image-size.note: Label of the file size meter, meaning data size in KiB, not width and height.

image-editor.ui.image-size-used-kib-of-2.text: Image size: {used} KiB of 256 KiB. Too big to save.
image-editor.ui.image-size-used-kib-of-2.note: Accessible description of the size meter when the image is over the limit. {used} is the size in KiB, a number.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

image-editor.ui.includes-connections.note: Hint under the delete hidden layers button: layers that other layers depend on are counted too.

image-editor.ui.inspector.note: Title of the side panel that shows settings for the selected layer or the image.

image-editor.ui.keep-ratio.note: Checkbox label: changing the width also changes the height so the proportions stay the same.

image-editor.ui.keywords.note: Label of the field for search words that help find the image in the library. A plural noun.

image-editor.ui.kib-is-a-kibibyte-a-litt.text: KiB is a kibibyte, a little over a thousand characters. 256 KiB is about a quarter of a megabyte.
image-editor.ui.kib-is-a-kibibyte-a-litt.note: Explanation under the image size line. It tells the user what the KiB unit means and how big the limit is.

image-editor.ui.layers.note: Heading of the list of drawing layers, the stacked parts of the image.

image-editor.ui.linear-gradient.note: Name of the linear gradient fill type, shown in the inspector. Same English as the paint option.

image-editor.ui.main.note: Name of the main text colour of the theme, shown as a colour label in the inspector. Same English as the paint option.

image-editor.ui.match-reference-picture.note: Canvas size option that takes the proportions of the reference picture.

image-editor.ui.min-to-max-pixels-per-si.note: Hint for the allowed canvas size. {min} and {max} are whole numbers, the smallest and largest side length.

vars.max: The value that replaces max in the text.
vars.min: The value that replaces min in the text.

image-editor.ui.more.note: Label of the button that opens extra actions for the image. Short for more actions.

image-editor.ui.more-details.note: Label of the expander that reveals the optional image fields: description, author and keywords.

image-editor.ui.name.note: Label of the field for the image name. A noun.

image-editor.ui.name-is-the-only-thing-y.text: Name is the only thing you need.
image-editor.ui.name-is-the-only-thing-y.note: Hint above the optional fields. Name is the field label, so keep it matching the Name label.

image-editor.ui.no-layers-yet.note: Empty state of the layers panel. It tells the user the drawing has no shapes yet.

image-editor.ui.none.note: Word shown when a fill or outline has no paint. Same English as the paint option None.

image-editor.ui.nothing-to-export-yet.note: Message in the export panel when the canvas is empty. It tells the user to draw something before exporting.

image-editor.ui.outline-paint.note: Summary line of a layer outline. {paint} is a colour name or value, or a word such as None.

vars.paint: The value that replaces paint in the text.

image-editor.ui.pick-a-shape-pixel-numbe.text: Pick a shape. Pixel numbers only set the drawing grid. The image scales to any card.
image-editor.ui.pick-a-shape-pixel-numbe.note: Hint in the canvas size panel. It tells the user the numbers only set the working grid and the saved image resizes to fit any card.

image-editor.ui.radial-gradient.note: Name of the radial gradient fill type, shown in the inspector. Same English as the paint option.

image-editor.ui.reload.note: Button next to the changed-elsewhere notice that loads the newer saved version, dropping local edits.

image-editor.ui.save.note: Button that saves the image in the library. A verb. Differs from Save image and Save as a copy.

image-editor.ui.save-as-a-copy.note: Button that saves under a new name and leaves the original as it was. No dots here, unlike the menu item.

image-editor.ui.save-image.note: Accessible name and tooltip of the main save button, saving the whole image.

image-editor.ui.saving.note: Label of the save button while saving is in progress. Same English as the status message.

image-editor.ui.select-the-biggest-layer.note: Button that selects the layer using the most data, so the user can simplify or delete it.

image-editor.ui.select-the-biggest-layer.text: Select the biggest layer and simplify it, or delete layers you do not need.
image-editor.ui.select-the-biggest-layer.note: Advice shown with the too-big size message. It tells the user two ways to bring the image under the limit.

image-editor.ui.shape.note: Label of the canvas shape choice, such as square or wide. A noun.

image-editor.ui.the-address-is-mcu-image.text: The address is mcu-image:{id}. It cannot be changed later.
image-editor.ui.the-address-is-mcu-image.note: Hint under the name field. {id} is the generated identifier of the image. Keep mcu-image: as written.

vars.id: The value that replaces id in the text.

image-editor.ui.this-image-was-changed-s.text: This image was changed somewhere else.
image-editor.ui.this-image-was-changed-s.note: Notice in the inspector with a Reload button. Same English as the save message.

image-editor.ui.too-big-to-save.note: Short warning label on the size meter when the image is over the limit.

image-editor.ui.undo.note: Toolbar button that reverts the last change. A verb.

image-editor.ui.use-a-number-from-min-to.note: Validation message for a number field. {min} and {max} are the lowest and highest allowed numbers.

vars.max: The value that replaces max in the text.
vars.min: The value that replaces min in the text.

image-editor.ui.used-of-256-kib-word.note: Size meter caption. {used} is the size in KiB, a number. {word} is a lower-case status word such as fine or nearly full.

vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.
vars.word: The value that replaces word in the text.

image-editor.ui.w-x-h-units-pick-a-layer.text: {w} x {h} units. Pick a layer to read its details.
image-editor.ui.w-x-h-units-pick-a-layer.note: Inspector hint when no layer is selected. {w} is the canvas width and {h} the height, as numbers in drawing units.

vars.h: The value that replaces h in the text.
vars.w: The value that replaces w in the text.

image-editor.ui.what-is-kib.note: Link or toggle that opens a short explanation of the KiB unit.

image-editor.ui.width.note: Field label for the canvas width, as a number in drawing units.

image-editor.ui.zoom-in.note: Button that makes the drawing area larger. A verb, paired with Zoom out.

image-editor.ui.zoom-out.note: Button that makes the drawing area smaller. A verb, paired with Zoom in.
